brief: A peaceful exploration theme for wandering through an enchanted forest, with gentle melodies and a sense of wonder

spec.description: A gentle, flowing orchestral piece with soft woodwind melodies drifting over lush string pads and delicate harp arpeggios, evoking the feeling of sunlight filtering through ancient enchanted trees. Subtle shimmering bell tones and light pizzicato strings add a sense of magic and childlike wonder, while a warm, unhurried rhythm invites exploration and curiosity.
spec.style_hint: Koji Kondo overworld style, Legend of Zelda enchanted forest feel, SNES-era JRPG orchestral warmth

brief: An intense, driving boss battle theme with heavy percussion, dramatic orchestral hits, and an aggressive tempo

spec.description: An intense, driving boss battle theme featuring thunderous taiko drums and heavy orchestral percussion, punctuated by dramatic brass stabs and powerful string ostinatos. Aggressive low brass and menacing choir swells build relentless tension, with fast-paced rhythmic hits creating an overwhelming sense of danger and high-stakes combat.
spec.style_hint: Yoko Shimomura or Hitoshi Sakimoto epic JRPG boss battle style, reminiscent of Final Fantasy or Kingdom Hearts climactic encounters

brief: A nostalgic 8-bit chiptune town theme reminiscent of classic JRPG menu music, upbeat and catchy

spec.description: A bright and catchy 8-bit chiptune town theme featuring bouncy square wave melodies layered over a cheerful arpeggio bassline, with punchy pulse wave harmonies and a crisp retro drum machine rhythm. The overall feel is warm, nostalgic, and inviting, evoking a peaceful village square in a classic JRPG world.
spec.style_hint: Koichi Sugiyama / early Dragon Quest NES era, 8-bit SNES chiptune JRPG town music
